description: T07 design note §9.5 (1), gate G20: every line of src/openflowsheet whose code (comments and strings excluded, W0.5's proposal) matches one of §9.5's patterns, with why it is not process-global mutable state that two jobs in one interpreter could share. Keyed by file and stripped line text; `occurrences` is how many lines of that file carry that text. A hit not listed here, or an entry with no hit, fails tests/test_t07_global_state.py.

entries.justification: T06 spec §8.1 (ADR 0014 D4, R-069): save/seed/restore of numpy's legacy generator around onenormest; safe with one computation per interpreter at a time, which the process executor guarantees (§9.4, R-088 Q27).
As the save above: the seeding, restored in a finally (JobInterrupted included).
As the save above: the restore.

entries.line: INTERRUPT_CHECK: ContextVar[Callable[[], None] | None] = ContextVar("INTERRUPT_CHECK", default=None)
entries.justification: §8.1's cooperative check: per thread and asyncio task, None outside a job, set and reset by jobs.interrupt.interruptible for the job running in that context only.
